examples.text: But I pitty the flatteries, and ſelfe-applauſes of a careleſſe and impenitent heart: This jollity hath in it much danger, and vvithout ſome change, death.

examples.text: Across the US, candidates traditionally attend rallies, barbecues and similar jollities in their states and districts.

glosses: Things, remarks, or characteristics which are enjoyable.

examples.text: Add to this picture a jolly, crackling, rollicking fire, going rejoicingly up a great wide chimney,—the outer door and every window being set wide open, and the calico window-curtain flopping and snapping in a good stiff breeze of damp raw air,—and you have an idea of the jollities of a Kentucky tavern.
